products.name: Perpetual Moon 41.5mm Platinum Limited Edition Mens Watch Celestial Blue
products.description: Blue moon The cold shimmer of a starry night. The diaphanous presence of a large mother-of-pearl moon. The pale gleam of platinum. Perpetual Moon 41. 5 Platinum “celestial blue” is expanding the collection’s different variations on the largest astronomical moon. Every part of this piece evokes the radiance of the night, from the dial stamped with the House’s “Stellar Rays” decor to the moon disc in a grained sky and the navy-blue alligator-leather strap.

products.name: Chronometry Ultrathin Tourbillon Red Gold 41.5mm Mens Watch Blue
products.description: Slim and textured To give the Ultrathin Tourbillon a unique and refined design, Arnold & Son has focused on materials and techniques that highlight the precious appearance of this finely honed tourbillon. Arnold & Son has used a manufacturing technique known as ‘Cosmic Grené’ on the dials. This name makes direct reference to stargazing, as stars are essential guides for navigating at sea along with marine chronometers (of which John Arnold was one of the largest and most reputable suppliers).Gold powder mixed with aluminium sparkles has been placed on the dial plate to create a lightly sandblasted surface. Due to the complex manufacturing methods involved, this dial is very subtle and finely textured, with a discreet lustre. At the heart of the Ultrathin Tourbillon lies the A&S8300 calibre, whose architecture and finesse characterise this collection. At just 2. 97 mm thick, this tourbillon with extremely refined finishes is one of the slimmest ever designed. The highest point of the A&S8300 calibre is located on the top of the tourbillon carriage, which has also been redesigned and undergone significant changes in relation to its predecessors. It features a variable-inertia balance with inertia blocks to ensure more stable calibration over time. The redesigned tourbillon carriage echoes the leading role John Arnold played in marine exploration during the 18th century. products.name: Roadmaster Rescue Chronograph 42mm Limited Edition Mens Watch Black
products.description: A purpose-built tool for critical search and rescue situations, the Roadmaster Rescue Chronograph delivers extreme accuracy, easy readability and high functionality. Engineered with a patented pusher locking system, the chronograph function works in unison with the pulsometer scale to measure heart rate, while two illuminated sub-dial counters track elapsed time. The two chronograph pushers on the flank of the case employ a new patented locking system to eliminate any unintentional manipulation. The pushers are engaged or locked by being turned. The constant operation indicator at 9 o’clock is also a re-engineering of the standard subsidiary seconds with greater visual impact. Atop the robust 41mm titanium-steel case of just 14. 8mm thickness, the steel bezel features a virtually scratchproof ceramic insert. To ensure perfect time reading even in total darkness, self-powered micro gas tubes are not only adorned on the dial and hands, an inset has also been added to the ceramic bezel. The tritium micro gas tubes require no charging and are always ready for action. At the core of the Rescue Chronograph is the automatic caliber BALL RR1402 that is protected by the patented Amortiser® anti-shock system. Going further and deeper, water resistance to 100 meters and a dive bezel enables decisive underwater action.

products.name: Fifty Fathoms Automatique 38mm Mens Watch Black
products.description: Secured movement A secured movement is a watchmaking innovation designed to protect delicate mechanisms and ensure lasting precision. By preventing accidental damage when setting the watch, it enhances reliability over time. At Blancpain, secured movements are a hallmark of our craftsmanship. Date In horology, a date complication refers to a feature on a watch that displays the current date. This is one of the most common and practical complications found in wristwatches. The date is typically shown through a small window or aperture on the dial.

products.name: Fifty Fathoms Automatique 42.3mm Mens Watch Black

It symbolises a heritage of exploration shaped by decades of innovation. Engineered for Depth Measuring 42. 3mm, this titanium design offers a lightweight yet durable construction. Its black dial hosts luminous Arabic numerals and baton indexes, perfectly complemented by an automatic calibre and a secure rubber strap.

products.name: Fifty Fathoms Automatique 42.3mm Mens Watch Black
products.description: This collection embodies Blancpain's passion for the underwater world, which the brand initially expressed in 1953 with the creation of the first modern diver's watch. Today, divers' Blancpain watches are more popular than ever. Founded in 1735, Blancpain is the world's oldest watchmaking brand. Over the years Blancpain has remained ever faithful to its tradition of innovation, and this quest for invention still drives the Master Watchmakers of the Manufacture in Switzerland today.

products.name: Fifty Fathoms Grande Date 45mm Mens Watch Black

Strength in Titanium Housed in a 45mm titanium case, this model features a black dial paired with Arabic numerals and baton markers. An automatic movement underscores precision, while a robust rubber strap ensures comfort in demanding aquatic environments.

products.name: Villeret

products.description: The slightly vaulted dial of the No. 33, with the characteristic subdials at 7 and 4: 30 , is back for a repeat performance as a key element of the brand DNA. "It is covered with a silvered sun-brushed dial," says Xavier de Roquemaurel, the CEO of Czapek & Cie and one of the three "guardians" of the company. "It's a unique shape to reproduce perfectly the enamel natural dome and it is produced by dial expert, Metalem." The dial is swept by blued triangular hands that display the time with great clarity as they pass the elongated numerals lacquered in a cool blue. The cases of the No. 25bis have been carefully designed according to a complex algorithm. "You immediately notice how organically the crown is integrated into the middle case and protected bytwo raised sections," de Roquemaurel points out, “it’s a revolution inside another revolution”. And the steel itself is not any ordinary stainless steel. Rather, it is an especially corrosion-resistant stainlesssteel variant provided by the Swiss family-run steel enterprise Montanstahl. The "XO steel” – its composition is still a secret – is tougher to machine, but the additional features makes it a very practical innovation in watchmaking. The Quai des Bergues No. 25bis is driven by a proprietary, manually-wound movement beating at 21, 600 vph. It was developed exclusively for Czapek & Cie in collaboration with Jean-François Mojon. products.name: Antarctique Polar Sky Limited Edition
products.description: Czapek's Antarctique Aventurine is a unique combination of elegance and zeitgeist. Like a smoking jacket over everyday pants and vice versa, codes are broken and reconciled to better combine and highlight each other. A unique style that allows the wearer stylistic subtlety and, above all, endless freedom of expression. For a wrist above 16. mm, its contained size of 40. 5mm, and above all its finesse, will be a guarantee of discreet but remarkable presence while combining an indisputable form of power thanks to its rough angles, its flanks open to the movement drum and its contrasting finishes. But let’s talk a bit more about the dressy part: Czapek has a longstanding love affair with aventurine, having harnessed its mysterious beauty for special editions of both Quai de Bergues (‘Midnight in Geneva’ limited edition to celebrate the first Geneva boutique opening, in 2019) and Faubourg de Cracovie (2022). “It’s a material that we love to play with, and it was a logical evolution to use it for the Antarctique – they were made to go together. Moreover, Antarctica is the world's best spot for stargazing!” says Czapek’s CEO Xavier de Roquemaurel. Aventurine is a type of glass, developed by chance when a 17th-century Murano glassmaker accidentally dropped some metal shavings into a cooling glass mixture, creating a multicoloured sparkle as they crystallised (its name is derived from all’avventura – Italian for ‘by chance’ and it pre-dates by at least a century the discovery of the

products.name: Antarctique Mount Erebus Deep Blue Full Rose Gold 5N Limited Edition
products.description: Located on Ross Island in the frozen continent, the mountain from which the new Antarctique takes its name is the southernmost active volcano on Earth and one of the very few constantly active volcanoes in the world. It was named after one of expedition ships that discovered Ross Island in 1841, HMS Erebus – which, in turn was named after a deity in Greek mythology born of Chaos and personifying darkness. A remarkable feature of this volcano is the presence in its lava of gold, which is projected into the atmosphere at an estimated rate of 80 grams per day, dissolved in the escaping volcanic gases and therefore impossible to harvest. The origins of Czapek’s Antarctique line are present in ‘Mount Erebus’ thanks to the lamé dial, a finish originally created for the first iteration of Antarctique, launched in May 2020 – the limited-edition Terre Adélie. Created in collaboration with Metalem, Czapek's long-time manufacturing partner, it is crafted using a special kind of comb that creates an effect like a highly textured satin finish. Complementing the rose gold ‘Mount Erebus’ case, the dial offered in Deep Blue is made with a CVD (chemical vapour deposit) technique.

products.name: Highlife Automatic Mens Watch Set
products.description: Frederique Constant watches are defined by their high quality and precision in design. All their watches are manufactured in Plan-les-Ouates Geneva, Switzerland and each one is assembled with care by hand. A smart and stylish automatic men's watch from the Classics collection by Frederique Constant. The rose gold-plated case holds a contrasting silver coloured dial with applied rose gold plated indexes. There is also a convenient date window and the watch is completed with a soft leather strap that secures with a pin and buckle.

products.name: Classics 40mm Mens Watch
products.description: Established in 1988 by Dutch entrepreneur Peter Stas and his wife and fellow entrepreneur Aletta Stas-Bax, Frederique Constant pay close attention design, innovation and quality. Each timepiece is hand-assembled and controlled over a long period of time to ensure the highest possible standard if timekeeping, making no compromises along the way. Frederique Constant proudly represent all corners of the market, making timepieces that can be enjoyed by everyone, not just elite groups in society. Passionate for a more traditional look, Frederique Constant has brought cutting edge technology to some of their models; enhancing functionality and user experience for the better.

products.name: Classics 42mm Mens Watch
products.description: Pure lines and a timeless design are the hallmarks of every watch within the Classics collection. Every timepiece within the Classics collection has been engineered to the most exacting standards.

products.name: Highlife Worldtimer Manufacture 41mm
products.description: What do you get when you combine the latest men’s collection from Frederique Constant with its globe-trotting Manufacture calibre? The answer is the Highlife Worldtimer Manufacture, a future icon. The globe engraved dial that features on this timepiece, with its contemporary 41 mm steel case, is sure to awaken the wanderlust in you. To this end, Frederique Constant has capitalised on the expertise of its Geneva-based manufacture. It’s here, in the birthplace of watchmaking, that the brand’s FC-718 calibre was designed, produced and assembled It is a movement of its time: modern, precise and reliable, not to mention tried and tested. Featuring at the forefront of the Highlife collection is a first and represents a major turning point for Frederique Constant. Tech meets style. The highly contemporary design of the 41 mm steel case and dial with globe engraving is an ode to travel. The FC-718 manufacture calibre is designed for exactly that. The self-winding mechanical movement has a power reserve of 38 hours. It is visible through the case back, water-resistant to 50 metres. Admire the typical Genevan finishes that Frederique Constant is so fond of, perlage and circular Côtes de Genève among them. To celebrate the arrival of this new model, the Manufacture has created not one, not two, but three straps for it – a rarity in watchmaking nowadays. The integrated interchangeable strap from the Highlife collection has become one of its characteristic features and Frederique Constant

products.name: Flying Officer Automatic 40mm Unisex Watch Orange Dial Fabric
products.description: First introduced in 1939, the Flying Officer was born in an era of growing world travel. Designed as a companion to the earliest intercontinental flights, it allowed pilots to track the time at upcoming refuelling stops via its rotating bezel. Worn by figures like former U. S. President Harry S. Truman, who called it “the most elaborate watch [he] ever saw,” it quickly moved beyond the cockpit, becoming a watch for those navigating a newly connected world. Today, the Flying Officer is reimagined for modern wanderlust with an updated city ring. Its timezones follow modern global gateways and routes of exploration, while its purpose remains unchanged: keeping time across cities and continents. It’s made to go far and stay in sync.

products.name: Multichron Sport Chronograph Automatic 41mm Unisex Watch Blue Dial Leather
products.description: First introduced in 1938, the Multichron collection was built for precision timekeeping across disciplines, from sport to exploration. By 1969, it evolved into the Multichron Pilot, a purpose-driven chronograph designed for long-duration timing and tracking a second timezone. Engineered for demanding conditions and built to endure, it delivers exceptional legibility for at-a-glance clarity in any light. Today, the new Multichron Pilot is reimagined for modern exploration. A go-anywhere, do-anything (a. k.a. GADA) watch, it moves with you through shifting weather, and altitude, while staying true to its original purpose: keeping time across distance.

products.name: Multichron Pilot Chronograph Automatic 42mm Unisex Watch Blue Dial Fabric
products.description: First introduced in 1938, the Multichron collection evolved into a series of chronographs built for precision timing across disciplines. In the 1960s, models like the Multichron 12 Scientific helped shape a more technical, performance-driven approach to timing. Over time, the collection became closely tied to the world of motorsport, where timing is crucial. Today, the Multichron Sport is made for all adventures on changing terrain, from asphalt and gravel to dunes and rougher ground. Staying true to its original purpose, it’s built to measure speed with precision through constantly shifting conditions. With its tachymeter scale and bold, high-contrast design, it performs across uncertain terrain, long after the road ends.

products.name: Classics B09 Tribute to Yachting Big Eye 38mm Unisex Watch White Dial Rubber
products.description: Born in the 1960s, the Multichron Yachting Big Eye chronograph was made for the rhythm of regatta racing, where every second before the start counts. Its distinctive countdown display brought clarity to the chaos of the pre-start phase, as boats manoeuvre for position in the final minutes before the gun, capturing the precision required at sea. Today, as part of Gallet’s 200th anniversary, the Tribute to Yachting Big Eye continues that story. A maritime chronograph designed for life on the water, it blends heritage with function, staying true to its origins: timing the decisive moments before the race begins.

products.name: Classics B09 Tribute to Multichron 38mm Unisex Watch Black Dial Fabric
products.description: The Multichron 45 was originally designed for precise interval timing, used across aviation and racing where clarity was essential. Its balanced dial and functional scales made it a reliable companion, easy to read even in low light. Today, as part of Gallet’s 200th anniversary, the Tribute to Multichron 45 reinterprets that approach with a more refined expression. Defined by its deep black dial and compact proportions, it brings a sense of quiet precision to the wrist, designed for clear, considered timekeeping in any setting. Anti-glare by day, luminescent by night, it stays legible through every hour, from early starts to overnight flights.

products.name: Classics B09 Tribute to Silverlight 38mm Unisex Watch Silver Dial Leather
products.description: Inspired by the Multichron Navigator, the Tribute to Silverlight returns as part of Gallet’s 200th anniversary. The original featured a distinctive display that offered a way to orient in motion, guiding its wearer toward true north, paired with softly irregular numerals that gave the dial rhythm and character. Today, that spirit returns in a more refined expression. With its silver-toned dial, flowing numerals, and vintage character, the Tribute to Silverlight is made for the modern voyager, guided less by coordinates than by instinct. A chronograph that moves with style from one place to the next.

products.name: Mini Maestro 30mm Unisex Watch Silver
products.description: The Mini Maestro Silver embodies timeless elegance through a refined interplay of light, texture, and diamond-set brilliance. Crafted in lightweight titanium with Ergon Teq comfort, it offers effortless wear and a graceful, jewelry-like presence. An intimate expression of Gerald Charles’ legacy, designed to elevate every moment from day to evening.

products.name: Mini Maestro 30mm Unisex Watch Pink
products.description: The Mini Maestro Pink reveals a soft yet confident aesthetic, celebrating beauty through subtle color and radiant detail. Its diamond accents and sculpted titanium case create a harmonious balance between sophistication and comfort. A versatile statement of style, designed to move effortlessly with the rhythm of modern life.

products.name: Mini Maestro 30mm Unisex Watch Blue
products.description: The Mini Maestro Ice Blue captures a fresh, luminous spirit, where delicate tones meet refined watchmaking artistry. Enhanced by a Clous de Paris dial and diamond-set bezel, it balances modern femininity with everyday versatility. A poetic creation that transforms with every occasion, blending technical precision with expressive elegance.

products.name: Maestro 2.0 Ultra-Thin 39mm Mens Watch Green
products.description: The watch's emerald green sunburst dial and vulcanised rubber strap, featuring the Clous de Paris motif on the top side and GC's logo tapisserie on the other, fully match the stainless steel of the Maestro case and the polished pin buckle with brushed applied plate and GC logo engraved. Thanks to the sunburst finish, a play of lights is created: different layers of colour emerge, sometimes warmer, sometimes cooler, depending on the light it reflects.

products.name: Maestro 2.0 Ultra-Thin 39mm Mens Watch Black
products.description: The watch's timeless black sunburst dial and vulcanised rubber strap, featuring the Clous de Paris motif on the top side and GC's logo tapisserie on the other, fully match the stainless steel of the Maestro case and the polished pin buckle with brushed applied plate and GC logo engraved. Thanks to the sunburst finish, a play of lights is created: different layers of colour emerge, sometimes warmer, sometimes cooler, depending on the light it reflects.

products.name: Maestro GC Sport Limited Edition 39mm Mens Watch Green
products.description: LIMITED EDITION OF 200 PIECES The GC Sport graduated green dial, with applied Arabic numerals at 3, 9 and 12, captures the spirit of the grass court tennis season. The watch's ergonomic case measuring only 8. 7mm in thinness and its lightweight design in polished Grade 5 titanium, make it possible for tennis players to wear it during the game. The matching vulcanized rubber strap is decorated with the Maison's signature Clous de Paris motif on the top side, and with Gerald Charles logo tapisserie on the other.

products.name: Maestro GC Sport Limited Edition 39mm Mens Watch Brown
products.description: LIMITED EDITION OF 200 PIECES The GC Sport fading russet-coloured dial, with applied Arabic numerals at 3, 9 and 12, captures the spirit of the clay court tennis season. The watch's ergonomic case measuring only 8. 7mm in thinness and its lightweight design in polished Grade 5 titanium, make it possible for tennis players to wear it during the game. The matching vulcanized rubber strap is decorated with the Maison's signature Clous de Paris motif on the top side, and with Gerald Charles logo tapisserie on the other.

products.name: Maestro GC Sport 39mm Mens Watch Blue
products.description: The GC Sport sunburst Royal Blue dial, with applied Arabic numerals at 3, 9 and 12, captures the spirit of the hard court tennis season. The watch's ergonomic case measuring only 8. 7mm in thinness and its lightweight design in polished Grade 5 titanium, make it possible for tennis players to wear it during the game. The matching vulcanized rubber strap is decorated with the Maison's signature Clous de Paris motif on the top side, and with Gerald Charles logo tapisserie on the other.

products.name: Maestro GC Sport Tennis 39mm Limited Edition Mens Watch White
products.description: LIMITED EDITION OF 250 PIECES The Maestro GC Sport Tennis White reinterprets high-performance watchmaking through the lens of tennis tradition, where purity, precision, and elegance define every detail. Crafted in hardened Darkblast titanium and engineered with Ergon Teq ergonomics, it delivers exceptional comfort, durability, and refined sporting functionality. A seamless fusion of technical mastery and timeless style, designed to perform effortlessly from Centre Court to everyday sophistication.

products.name: Maestro GC Sport Tennis
products.description: LIMITED EDITION OF 200 PIECES The GC Sport Tennis features a Darkblast® titanium case and a grainy-textured yellow dial with applied Arabic numerals at 3, 9, and 12. Inspired by modern tennis aesthetics, its ultralight Velcro strap, crafted in-house in Geneva, mirrors the dial’s porous effect. Tested and approved by professional players, it boasts 5G shock resistance, weighs only 64 grams, and features a left-hand crown to prevent rubbing during matches. The Ergon Teq® design ensures the lugs, case, and strap sit ergonomically, adapting to all wrist sizes for maximum stability and weight distribution. Engineered for performance and versatility, this timepiece embodies Gerald Charles’ commitment to innovation and comfort.

products.name: Maestro GC Sport Tennis Light Turquoise Limited Edition 41mm Mens Watch
products.description: LIMITED EDITION OF 100 PIECES A color never before seen in the Maestro GC Sport collection: Light Turquoise. Vibrant yet refined, bold yet elegant, this distinctive shade brings fresh energy to one of the Maison’s most recognizable creations. The dial reveals a delicate gradient effect enhanced by a unique granular texture, creating a captivating interplay of depth and light that changes continuously with every movement of the wrist. Dynamic and expressive, the Light Turquoise dial transforms the watch into a true statement piece while preserving the understated sophistication that defines Gerald Charles.

products.name: Masterlink Blue 38mm Mens Watch Blue
products.description: Keeping up with the asymmetry, the case and the bracelet of Masterlink are no less impressive. The Masterlink case still features the iconic “smile” at 6 o’clock yet changing on the top and becoming squarer. Therefore, the bracelet links echo the sinuous curve at the bottom while following the geometrical lines on the top. products.name: Maestro 3.0 Chronograph 39mm Mens Watch Green
products.description: The Maestro 3. 0 Chronograph in medical-grade stainless steel features an emerald green sunburst dial. The vulcanized rubber strap in emerald green features its classic double-face decoration with Clous de Paris on one side and the GC logo's tapisserie on the other. The watch is water-resistant to 100 metres.

products.name: Maestro 2.0 Ultra-Thin Gem-Set 39mm Mens Watch Black
products.description: The watch's timeless black sunburst dial and vulcanised rubber strap, featuring the Clous de Paris motif on the top side and GC's logo tapisserie on the other, fully match the stainless steel of the Maestro case and the polished pin buckle with brushed applied plate and GC logo engraved. Thanks to the sunburst finish, a play of lights is created: different layers of colour emerge, sometimes warmer, sometimes cooler, depending on the light it reflects. The precious gemstones on the bezel enhance the sunburst dial finish.

products.name: Maestro 2.0 Meteorite Silver Limited Edition 39mm Watch
products.description: The Maestro 2. 0 Meteorite, the Maison’s first meteorite timepiece to feature a small-seconds indicator, is a 100-piece limited edition crafted in a polished stainless-steel case, powered by the ultra-thin Swiss Manufacture automatic Calibre GCA2011 and water-resistant to 100 metres, distinguished by its striking two-level Muonionalusta meteorite dial that brings a truly cosmic character to the watch. A striking dual-layer construction: a thin slab of meteorite above an aluminum silver baseplate. Radial apertures pierce the dial to expose the charged baseplate beneath, evoking the shockwaves of impact. Roman numerals and indexes appear shifted, tilted, displaced as though physically pushed aside by the force of the blast. The white Velcro strap is a true testament to innovation and craftsmanship. Designed with maximum comfort in mind and crafted in-house in Geneva, the strap is hand-stitched and includes an iron core, ensuring both flexibility and strength. The easy removal system allows customers to effortlessly change the strap, offering a personalized and convenient experience, while maintaining the Maison’s signature quality and attention to detail.

products.name: Maestro GC Sport Gem-Set 39mm Mens Watch Blue

The watch's ergonomic case measuring only 8. 7mm in thinness and its lightweight design in polished Grade 5 titanium, make it possible for tennis players to wear it during the game. The matching vulcanized rubber strap is decorated with the Maison's signature Clous de Paris motif on the top side, and with Gerald Charles logo tapisserie on the other. The precious gemstones on the bezel enhance the sunburst dial finish.

products.name: Maestro 3.0 Chronograph 39mm Mens Watch Blue

The watch features a royal blue sunburst dial and the iconic indexes and peculiar hands shape, filled with Super-Lumi Nova, directly coming from Mr. Gérald Charles Genta's original drawings.

products.name: Maestro 3.0 Chronograph

products.name: Maestro 8.0 Squelette 39mm Mens Watch Skeleton
products.description: The Maestro 8. 0 Squelette features some satin-finished and rhodium plated open-worked bridges, some others treated with anthracite NAC. All angles, bevels and apertures are diamond-cut and hand-polished, and the yellowgold wheels are decorated with circular graining, a traditional high-end watchmaking finish. The rehaut features white painted minute markers and hands filled with highly luminous Super-Lumi Nova. The rehaut is retained by a series of nine, star-shaped screws that were designed and developed specifically for Gerald Charles. The black vulcanized rubber strap is decorated with the Maison's signature Clous de Paris motif on the top side, and with Gerald Charles logo tapisserie on the other.

Furthermore, the hands are filled with white Super-Lumi Nova, while the minute-track is in poudré Rose Gold 4N.

products.description: The ideal travel companion appears with a fresh, powerful look. Its stainless steel case is perfectly polished/satin-brushed and has a diameter of 44mm. This masterpiece is fitted with a deep blue Louisiana alligator leather strap, a blue or grey synthetic fabric strap, or a stainless steel bracelet with fine adjustment mechanism. Globetrotters wearing the Senator Cosmopolite are optimally equipped for their travels. The central hour and minute hands on the dial show the local time at destination, while the home time is easily read from the auxiliary dial at 12 o'clock. Here, too, are the useful day/night indicator and the cleverly integrated power reserve display. The small seconds, the day/night indicator for the destination time and the signature Panorama Date complete the clear design. Even in daylight, the hour and minute hands appear in high contrast to the galvanic blue dial with its sunray finish. Equally easy to read are the printed white numerals, markings and letterings on the various displays. The timepiece reveals all its charm under difficult lighting conditions: the central hands and hour indexes are inlaid with white Super-Lumi Nova. This watch's time zone ring offers a choice of 35 world time zones. The 24 time zones that diverge from Greenwich Mean Time (GMT) in full hour increments are displayed using a white IATA code. A further eight time zones with 1/2 - hour differences and the remaining time zones with 3/4 hour offsets are represented in light blue IAT

Like all the watches in the Senator Excellence line, this new variant was designed with the highest demands on suitablilty for everyday use, durability and timeless aesthetics. The sapphire crystal case back provides an unobstructed view of the finely finished automatic movement. The timepiece is optionally equipped with a blue Louisiana alligator leather strap, a robust blue synthetic strap or a stainless steel bracelet. The perpetual calendar is considered one of the most sophisticated complications in the art of watchmaking. Its ingenious mechanism bears witness to the expertise, dexterity and passion of its developers: the calendar function represents the correct relationship between the date, day of the week and leap year until the secular year 2100. With the Senator Excellence Perpetual Calendar, Glashutte Original gives this tradition-steeped complication a particularly contemporary face. On the grey galvanised dial, the Panorama Date as well as the weekday and month windows are subtly set off by small frames. The leap years are visualised with the help of separate display below 12 o'clock. The Roman numerals in solid gold are coated in blue while the hour and minute hands in steel are traditionally blued. products.name: Senator Excellence Panorama Date Moon Phase 40mm Mens Watch Silver
products.description: This Senator Excellence Panorama Date Moon Phase is presented in a red gold case measuring 40mm in diameter and reflects the pure essence of Glashutte Original with its clear, elegant design. A timeless classic, the watch combines traditional stylistic elements with contemporary requirements. A brown Louisiana alligator nubuck leather strap with a double-folding clasp in red gold ensures a secure fit on the wrist. The exquisite dial with fine silver graining is made in-house by true masters of their craft. Behind a curved dial opening, a gold-coloured moon traces its path. Careful diamond cutting creates a sharp outer line that stands out clearly against the galvanic blue firmament. A finely crafted window at 4 o'clock frames the Glashutte Original Panorama Date, which is clearly legible with black numerals on a light background. With this new watch model, the Panorama Date and moon phase can also be easily adjusted via the crown, which makes an additional corrector on the case superflouse. Position 1 of the crown is used to wind the watch, in position 2 the date and moon phase can be adjusted, and in position 3 the time is set. Thanks to its finely toothed wheel ,the moon phase is highly accurate: theoretically, it only needs to be corrected by one day after 122 years. products.name: Ultra-Chron Classic 40mm Mens Watch Silver Alligator
products.description: In 1968, LONGINES launched the Ultra-Chron Diver, the first dive watch equipped with a high-frequency movement. At the time, LONGINES had already established itself as a pioneer in high-frequency technology. As early as 1910, the winged hourglass brand created the first high-frequency timekeeping device capable of measuring 1/10th of a second. In 1959, LONGINES developed the first high-beat movement for a wristwatch, an observatory chronometer that set new records in terms of accuracy. The new Ultra-Chron is inspired by the aesthetic codes and professional diving features of the 1968 model. These chronometer-certified watches are powered by an exclusive LONGINES calibre equipped with a silicon balance-spring and resistant to magnetic fields.

products.name: Spirit Pilot Flyback Chronograph 39.5mm Mens Watch Leather Black
products.description: At the heart of the Spirit collection stands the Longines Spirit Pilot Flyback, a testament to the brand’s pioneering role in flyback chronograph development. This sophisticated timepiece celebrates a technology Longines invented in the early 1930s, when the brand produced the first flyback chronograph watches before filing its groundbreaking patent in 1935. The new Spirit Pilot Flyback presents reimagined dimensions within a refined 39. 5-mm stainless steel case, measuring just 13. 4 mm thick for a sleeker, more comfortable profile. The bidirectional rotating bezel benefits from an improved rotating system and introduces a countdown timer for the first time, while the box-shaped sapphire crystal and matt black dial create the distinctive aesthetic of vintage aviation instruments. Gold-coloured hands and applied numerals treated with Super-Lumi Nova® ensure exceptional visibility, while honouring the functional requirements that made pilot watches essential cockpit tools.

products.name: Spirit Pilot Flyback 39.5mm Mens Watch Blue
products.description: The LONGINES Spirit Pilot Flyback collection captures the brand’s persistent drive for innovation. This chronograph, with its flyback function, highlights LONGINES’ pioneering expertise in this field. The winged hourglass brand introduced its first flyback-equipped model in the early 1930s and secured a patent for the technology on June 16, 1936, marking a world-first achievement. Designed as a groundbreaking tool for pilots, the flyback complication makes it possible to time successive flight stages, greatly enhancing navigational efficiency. The precision of the LONGINES Spirit Pilot Flyback is powered by an exclusive Longines calibre, fitted with a silicon balance spring and resistant to magnetic fields. This hand-wound mechanical movement is officially certified as a chronometer by the COSC. Manual winding watch, 39. 50 mm, Stainless steel and ceramic bezel, L3. 721. 4.93. 9Chronograph, flyback, mechanical movement with manual winding beating at 28'800 vibrations per hour, with a power reserve of approximately 68 hours. Bi-directional rotating bezel, water-resistant to 10 bar, scratch-resistant sapphire crystal, with several layers of anti-reflective coating on both sides. Blue matt dial, swiss Super-Lumi Nova®.Rubber strap bracelet, with buckle.

products.name: Ultra-Chron 43mm Mens Watch
products.description: In 1968, LONGINES launched the Ultra-Chron Diver, the first dive watch equipped with a high-frequency movement. At the time, LONGINES had already established itself as a pioneer in high-frequency technology. As early as 1914, the winged hourglass brand created the first high-frequency timekeeping device capable of measuring 1/10th of a second. In 1959, LONGINES developed the first high-beat movement for a wristwatch, an observatory chronometer that set new records in terms of accuracy. The new Ultra-Chron is inspired by the aesthetic codes and professional diving features of the 1968 model. These chronometer-certified watches are powered by an exclusive LONGINES calibre equipped with a silicon balance-spring and resistant to magnetic fields.

The brand has produced a large number of pilots' watches and chronographs, on-board equipment and other navigation instruments which aided the development of civil and military aviation during the first half of the 20th century. Today, Longines is bringing this exciting heritage back to life with watches from its 'Heritage Avigation' range.

products.name: Mini DolceVita 21.5mm X 29mm Ladies Watch Silver
products.description: With its discreet profile, classic styling, and aesthetic variations that are at once timely and timeless, the Mini Dolce Vita exquisitely expresses, in equal parts, Longines’ quiet luxury and contemporary elegance. The meticulously designed collection is an extension of the original Dolce Vita family, inspired by a Longines legend created in 1927. Presented in an impressive range of materials and colours, the Mini Dolce Vita watches feature a discreet 21. 50mm x 29mm case and are available with or without diamonds.

products.name: Excellence Petite Seconde 39mm Unisex Watch Blue
products.description: Louis Erard extends the range of one of the flagship models of its Excellence collection, the Petite Seconde, with three colours inspired by the codes of contemporary high-end watchmaking: midnight blue, purple and ice blue. In a new 39 mm steel case. Midnight blue marks the return of a great classic. A colour that has become the long-standing travelling companion of prestige watchmaking, which is obviously part of the long history of Louis Erard, and which now returns to the heart of the collection, on a dark blue grained calf leather strap with tone-on-tone attachment points, and its blue grained calf leather lining, now a classic of the House.

products.name: Excellence Petite Seconde 39mm Unisex Watch Purple
products.description: Louis Erard extends the range of one of the flagship models of its Excellence collection, the Petite Seconde, with three colours inspired by the codes of contemporary high-end watchmaking: midnight blue, purple and ice blue. In a new 39 mm steel case. The colour purple is a subtle reminder that contemporary watchmaking, even if it remains centred on its values of durability, is also made up of trends and sometimes allows itself to go beyond its normal codes. Purple, enhanced by the contrast of polished hands and indexes, embodies this ability to reinvent oneself. This colour came from the top of the range; Louis Erard makes it accessible. The watch is finished with a purple grained calf leather strap with tone-on-tone attachment points and blue grained calf leather lining.

products.name: Excellence Petite Seconde 39mm Unisex Watch Blue
products.description: Louis Erard extends the range of one of the flagship models of its Excellence collection, the Petite Seconde, with three colours inspired by the codes of contemporary high-end watchmaking: midnight blue, purple and ice blue. In a new 39 mm steel case. Ice blue has become a rallying point for high-end and even very high-end watches. A flashy colour to which Louis Erard adds its touch of harmony, with a hint of colour on the dark blue and polished hands, an ice blue grained calf leather strap with dark blue attachment points and its lining in blue grained calf leather. Here again, Louis Erard takes up the challenge of proving that the codes of luxury should not remain perched on unaffordable segments.

products.name: Excellence Petite Seconde Guilloché 42mm Unisex Watch Grey
products.description: The Excellence Petite Seconde Guilloché features a four-part dial. The center catches the eye with its radiant draped pattern, a light trap where the flatness of the dial deepens into evolving waves, growing from the center. A classic effect of flinqué guilloché – traditionally practised manually on a rose engine. This central panel is encircled, a classic transition that leads to the large hour circle, covered with a panier motif, finely staggered like scales. A new hoop closes the design, followed by a minute “rail track”. The small seconds subdial at 6 o’clock displays the same guilloché patterns in darker tones. The visual impact of guillochage is further accentuated by the two-tone anthracite combination within a 42mm case. Remaining true to Louis Erard’s ethos, every detail is meticulously crafted, from the signature fir tree hands to the monogrammed crown and Sellita calibre movement. And with its affordable price point, it stands in stark contrast to other manufacturers in this category, making it an accessible luxury timepiece.

products.name: Excellence Petite Seconde Guilloché 39mm Unisex Watch Blue
products.description: The Excellence Petite Seconde Guilloché features a four-part dial. The center catches the eye with its radiant draped pattern, a light trap where the flatness of the dial deepens into evolving waves, growing from the center. A classic effect of flinqué guilloché – traditionally practised manually on a rose engine. This central panel is encircled, a classic transition that leads to the large hour circle, covered with a panier motif, finely staggered like scales. A new hoop closes the design, followed by a minute “rail track”. The small seconds subdial at 6 o’clock displays the same guilloché patterns in darker tones. The visual impact of guillochage is further accentuated by a blend anthracite and blue combination within a 39mm case. Remaining true to Louis Erard’s ethos, every detail is meticulously crafted, from the signature fir tree hands to the monogrammed crown and Sellita calibre movement. And with its affordable price point, it stands in stark contrast to other manufacturers in this category, making it an accessible luxury timepiece.

products.name: Le Régulateur x Seconde/Seconde/ Limited Edition 42mm Unisex Watch Silver
products.description: Once again, Louis Erard is putting its iconic regulator to the test of free collaboration with an independent creator, seconde/seconde/. And this time, a taboo has been lifted in the world of fine watchmaking: the internet takes its place at the heart of the mechanism, with the dreaded “404 Error” reinterpreted as a minute hand. And Louis Erard has the courage to say so: human beings wouldn’t be complete without a good dose of humour and self-mockery. From Louis Erard to Louis Error. 404 Error: just like faulty addressing in computing, there’s an error in the fitting - this hour does not exist. 404 Error: except that this hand returns to cross the dial with a blue line each time the minute strikes quarter to the hour.

products.name: Excellence Petite Seconde Malachite Limited Edition 39mm Unisex Watch Green
products.description: Excellence Petite Seconde Malachite — All the outward signs of luxury in a fresh and contemporary outfit. All the art of Louis Erard, who pursues his mission: to make fine watchmaking accessible. Not just in terms of price or exclusivity, but also in terms of design and spirit.

products.name: Excellence Régulateur Lapis-Lazuli Limited Edition 42mm Unisex Watch Blue
products.description: The Excellence Régulateur Lapis-Lazuli is the deep azure of early dawn, the blue hour suspended between night and the new day. A flash of Yves Klein blue on the wrist. And as if we needed reminding, lapis lazuli is a cerulean blue metamorphic rock dotted with silicate inclusions. A stone of inner peace. An ornamental stone that has survived millennia, and from which man has long extracted an ultramarine blue pigment more precious than gold. Once again, Louis Erard is going off the beaten track by combining contemporary design and high-end watchmaking expertise in fine stone dials, geological time and mechanical precision, the visible signs of luxury and accessible fine watchmaking.

products.name: 2340 Blue 40mm Mens Watch Blue
products.description: Meet our first watch with an integrated bracelet: 2340, the postal code of our home in Le Noirmont, now a symbol of a new chapter. A new bracelet. A new case. A movement that is a first in our collections. Every detail, technical, aesthetic, driven to the point of obsession. A model built to last. Not a limited edition. A foundational piece. Our take on sporty-chic, the Louis Erard way.

products.name: 2340 Slate 40mm Mens Watch
products.description: Meet our first watch with an integrated bracelet: 2340, the postal code of our home in Le Noirmont, now a symbol of a new chapter. A new bracelet. A new case. A movement that is a first in our collections. Every detail, technical, aesthetic, driven to the point of obsession. A model built to last. Not a limited edition. A foundational piece. Our take on sporty-chic, the Louis Erard way.

products.description: Meet our first watch with an integrated bracelet: 2340, the postal code of our home in Le Noirmont, now a symbol of a new chapter. A new bracelet. A new case. products.description: Meet our first watch with an integrated bracelet: 2340, the postal code of our home in Le Noirmont, now a symbol of a new chapter. A new bracelet. A new case. A movement that is a first in our collections. Every detail, technical, aesthetic, driven to the point of obsession. A model built to last. Not a limited edition. A foundational piece. products.name: 2340 Mauve 40mm Mens Watch Purple
products.description: Meet our first watch with an integrated bracelet: 2340, the postal code of our home in Le Noirmont, now a symbol of a new chapter. A new bracelet. A new case. A movement that is a first in our collections. Every detail, technical, aesthetic, driven to the point of obsession. A model built to last. Not a limited edition. A foundational piece. Our take on sporty-chic, the Louis Erard way.

products.name: Le Régulateur x Atelier Oï Limited Edition 42mm Unisex Watch Grey
products.description: For this new collaboration, Louis Erard turns to architecture and design with atelier oï, a regional company that has been shining internationally for 30 years, and a radiant watch, too. atelier oï proceeded in a basic way: “To radiate from the centre outwards.” Taking care to reduce the technical vocabulary as much as possible, reminiscent of the shape of a sundial. The result is a surface engraved with asymmetrical rays, the light of which reveals reflections and contrasts – echoing the passion of the members of atelier oï for the material and the play of light. The art of engraving being expressed here in its essence: drawn lines. These lines create a space, to which the hands add the dimension of time.

products.name: Le Régulateur x Massena Lab Limited Edition 42mm Unisex Watch Gold
products.description: This is not a watch, it is a meeting place between a contemporary watch and a 19th century marine chronometer with its own guiding principle. As William Massena explains: “A successful collaboration is one that makes sense. Louis Erard allowed me to mix codes, to cite the classicism of a master watchmaker like Antide Janvier, and to democratise a style that’s usually reserved for wealthy collectors”.

products.name: 2340 Louis Erard X Astro Boy 40mm Limited Edition Mens Watch
products.description: Meet our first watch with an integrated bracelet: 2340, the postal code of our home in Le Noirmont, now a symbol of a new chapter. A new bracelet. A new case. A movement that is a first in our collections. Every detail, technical, aesthetic, driven to the point of obsession. A model built to last. Not a limited edition. A foundational piece. Our take on sporty-chic, the Louis Erard way.

products.name: Métiers d'art Émail Grand Feu II Limited Edition 39mm Unisex Watch White
products.description: Louis Erard continues its odyssey at the heart of métiers d’art with Grand Feu enamel. A new interpretation of this exclusive craft already explored in 2021, which returns in a contemporary classic with subtlety. Every colour you see on a watch requires processing in a kiln at more than 800°C. The artisan’s dexterity changes nothing: you cannot play with fire with impunity and, despite an expert touch, the high level of waste is irreducible. When everything goes well, the result is total. The quality of a Grand Feu enamel dial is unsurpassable. Due to the complexity of the craft, artisans can only produce up to 15 dials/month.

products.name: Métiers d'art Guilloché Main II Limited Edition 42mm Unisex Watch Grey
products.description: Louis Erard continues to reinvent traditional métiers d’art with this second hand guilloché dial. Guilloché is no longer a question of decoration; it’s a subject in and of itself: a large diamond, an ace of diamonds, with a kinetic feel. It’s no longer a question of revisiting an old aesthetic, but of putting the technique at the service of a contemporary composition. The guilloché required all the dexterity of the guillocheuse: the artisan produces the 99 dials piece by piece, each one taking several hours of work on the manual guilloché rose engine lathe. Not to mention the engineers, who had to invent and manufacture new cams to achieve this unprecedented result.

products.name: Le Chronographe Monopoussoir x Massena Lab Limited Edition 43mm Unisex Watch Silver
products.description: Much more than a chronograph. The second collaboration between Louis Erard and Massena LAB, two platforms dedicated to accessible collector’s watches. An air of the 19th century. A concentration of classic codes in a resolutely contemporary model equipped with a 21st-century monopusher chronograph calibre.

products.name: Le Régulateur x Alain Silberstein Limited Edition 40mm Unisex Watch Green
products.description: Louis Erard has once again called on the watchmaking artist Alain Silberstein, and has reached a new summit: the tourbillon. Not just any tourbillon. A tourbillon coupled with a regulator display. An exclusive tourbillon (78 pieces, in a triptych, with La Semaine Louis Erard x Alain Silberstein and Le Régulateur Louis Erard x Alain Silberstein). An affordable tourbillon. A contemporary tourbillon: khaki-coloured, sporty, chic, contemporary.

products.name: Le Régulateur x Cédric Johner Limited Edition 39mm Unisex Watch Blue
products.description: Louis Erard’s new collaboration represents a new stage in the exploration of fine contemporary watchmaking. This time, the collaboration with watchmaker and jeweler Cédric Johner takes craftsmanship to new heights, as he personally hand-decorates the oscillating weight of each movement. With a sleek 39-millimeter case available in two captivating variations – blue and mauve – this limited edition release consists of two sets of 178 meticulously crafted pieces each.

products.name: Le Régulateur x Cédric Johner Limited Edition 39mm Unisex Watch Purple
products.description: Louis Erard’s new collaboration represents a new stage in the exploration of fine contemporary watchmaking. This time, the collaboration with watchmaker and jeweler Cédric Johner takes craftsmanship to new heights, as he personally hand-decorates the oscillating weight of each movement. With a sleek 39-millimeter case available in two captivating variations – blue and mauve – this limited edition release consists of two sets of 178 meticulously crafted pieces each.

products.name: Le Régulateur x Konstantin Chaykin Time Eater III Limited Edition 42mm Mens Watch Grey
products.description: Louis Erard disrupts the status quo, making artisanal craftsmanship accessible. Its artistic crafts timepieces defy tradition with a contemporary edge, shaped by boundary-breaking artisans. Since 1929, independence has fueled their fire, inspired by the untamed spirit of the Swiss jura and building upon the iconic regulators and mechanical watches.

products.name: Le Régulateur Louis Erard X Vianney Halter II Worldwide Edition Limited Edition 43mm Mens Watch
products.description: Le Regulateur II is back on stage, same unmistakable design, same electric blued steel hands, now sharper than ever with a new silver monochrome dial. A watch orbiting between reality and fiction, transcending the boundaries of both time and space!

products.name: Louis Erard X Konstantin Chaykin Unfrogettable Purple 40mm Limited Edition Mens Watch
products.description: Once upon a time... No, this is once upon a twist. Louis Erard and Konstantin Chaykin are back, to flip the script, twist traditions and leap over conventions with a grin. Yes, it really jumps out at you. Introducing the Unfrogettable. A Frog Princess like you've never seen before. Born in Slavic myth, suited in samurai armor, built in the Swiss Jura. A fully reworked case. A regulator turned creature. A spell you can wear. Powered by Chaykin's ingenious mind and Louis Erard's rebellious spirit. The result? Something no one asked for, but no one will forget. Beyond the fun, precision. Beyond the madness, mastery.

products.name: Fil D'or Louis Erard X Wire Art Likmited Edition 39mm Mens Watch
products.description: Louis Erard keeps doing what it does best: shining a light on talent, artisans, craft and bold ideas. Introducing Fil d’Or. A collaboration with Sylvie Villa & Mark Miehlbradt, founders of Wire Art. Engineers by training. Artists by conviction. Their machines once wired the digital world. Now they wire time. This isn’t just decoration. It’s a new artistic craft. Fil d’Or is a thread of innovation, soldered to craftsmanship.

products.name: Gravee Main 42mm Mens Watch Black
products.description: Gravée Main marks a new milestone in Louis Erard’s Métiers d’Art series. Hand engraving takes center stage in a limited series of 99 unique timepieces. From case to bezel and from lugs and crown to buckle, every metal element is fully hand-engraved and finished in a demanding process taking more than 50 hours. Hand engraving brings something machines can’t: uniqueness. Each cut, each curve is done by hand. No two are alike. Just one artist, one piece of steel. The Gravée Main is art. isanship on the wrist.

products.name: Aikon Automatic Date 35mm Ladies Watch Black Mother Of Pearl
products.description: Urban-inspired, contemporary aesthetics, ergonomic design and a mechanical heart, make this the ideal accompaniment to city life. With its playful use of contrasts and shapes, the AIKON Automatic makes a bold statement.

products.name: Deco Madison Mini Diamond Stainless Steel Ladies Watch
products.description: This petite stainless steel rectangular timepiece perfectly balances vintage-inspired style with a modern edge. The white mother-of-pearl dial shines with 122 diamond accents (0. 43 carat weight) and Swiss movement. The stainless steel bracelet is made specifically for the Deco Madison Mini collection and is interchangeable with any 12 mm MICHELE strap.

products.name: Deco Madison Mid 18K Gold-Plated Diamond Dial Watch
products.description: This 18K gold-plated Deco Madison Mid shines with 40 hand-set diamonds atop the silver white sunray dial. The gold bracelet is made specifically for the Deco Madison Mid collection and is interchangeable with any 16 mm MICHELE strap.

products.name: Meggie 18K Gold-Plated Diamond Dial Watch
products.description: Elegant curves add modern elegance to the case of MICHELE's stunning Meggie watch that sparkles with 60 hand-set diamonds (0. 19 carat weight) on the mother-of-pearl dial with diamond inner ring and double diamond indexes. This watch features a Swiss movement and a gleaming 14mm seven-link 18K gold-plated seven-link bracelet made specifically for the Meggie collection interchangeable with any 14mm MICHELE strap.

products.name: Deco Madison Mini Diamond Two-Tone 18K Gold-Plated Watch
products.description: This petite two-tone stainless steel and 18K gold-plated rectangular timepiece perfectly balances vintage-inspired style with a modern edge. The white mother-of-pearl dial shines with 122 diamond accents (0. 43 carat weight) and Swiss movement. The two-tone 18K gold-plated bracelet is made specifically for the Deco Madison Mini collection and is interchangeable with any 12 mm MICHELE strap.

products.name: Deco Mid Stainless Diamond Dial Ladies Watch
products.description: This two-tone Deco Madison Mid shines with 148 hand-set diamonds on the bezel and atop the silver white sunray dial. The two-tone bracelet is made specifically for the Deco Madison Mid collection and is interchangeable with any 16 mm MICHELE strap.

products.name: Meggie Two-Tone 18K Gold-Plated Diamond Watch
products.description: Elegant curves add modern elegance to the case of MICHELE's stunning Meggie watch that sparkles with 64 hand-set diamonds on the top ring in our signature MW pattern and a mother-of-pearl dial with diamond inner ring and signature diamond indexes. This watch features a Swiss movement and a gleaming 14 mm two-tone stainless steel seven-link bracelet made specifically for the Meggie collection interchangeable with any 14 mm MICHELE strap.

products.name: Star Legacy Small Second 32mm Ladies Watch
products.description: With writing instruments, wallets, cufflinks and a host of other products that never compromise on materials or the workmanship used, Montblanc will be able to provide you with the perfect gift. Guided by the pioneering spirit since 1906, Montblanc revolutionized the culture of writing with breakthrough innovations. Today, the Maison continues to push boundaries and evolve the expression of fine craftsmanship across each of its product categories: the pinnacle of luxury writing instruments, timepieces, leather goods, accessories, fragrances and eyewear. With every innovation, Montblanc offers new functionalities and ground-breaking designs imbued with the Maison's heritage of sophistication and crafted to the highest standards through the skills of its artisans in each of its manufactures whether Hamburg, Germany for its writing instruments, Le Locle and Villeret in the Swiss Jura for its timepieces or Florence, Italy for its leather goods. Discover the all-encompassing collection that Montblanc has to offer.

products.name: Star Legacy Small Second Ladies Watch
products.description: This ladies watch adopts a silver Arabic dial with a star guilloche-pattern centre. Displaying the time, Anthracite Arabic numerals and steel hands sit beneath the sapphire crystal. This timepiece also features a small seconds display at the 6 o'clock position with a diamond set surround. All of which are water resistant up to 30 Metres.

products.name: Star Legacy 42mm Mens Watch
products.description: The Montblanc 128681 Star Legacy watch takes its inspiration from Minervas heritage and the companys pocket watches that were made during the late 19th century and early 20th century. It combines a 42mm round shaped stainless steel case and black leather strap with a traditional buckle. It has a white analogue dial with black Arabic numerals and a date display which is protected beneath scratch resistant sapphire crystal glass. Power is generated by the Swiss-made calibre MB 24. 17 automatic movement with 26 jewels and a power reserve of up to 38 hours. This model also has a sapphire crystal case back and a water resistance of up to 50 metres.

products.name: Star Legacy Automatic Date 42 mm
products.description: In celebration of the 20th anniversary of the Montblanc’s Star Collection this year, the Maison reinvents its iconic collection with timepieces inspired by the extraordinary patrimony of the Minerva Manufacture, reinterpreting both the collection’s aesthetics and technology. The Star Legacy Automatic Date is the purest timepiece of the collection. It displays all the design codes of the line, including a refined dial featuring the Montblanc iconic exploding star guilloché pattern, leaf-shaped hours and minutes hands, redesigned Breguet-style Arabic numerals reminiscent of the historical Minerva pocket watches, a filet sauté (up and down guilloché lines), a unique railway minute track and a seconds hand with the Montblanc emblem at its tip. The watch is housed in a 42 mm stainless steel case, features a silvery-white dial and comes with a shiny metal bracelet that has been developed for utmost comfort.

products.name: 1858 GMT 42mm
products.description: Where most GMT timepieces indicate the second time zone with an additional hand, the Montblanc 1858 GMT presents its GMT indication without hands that is very intuitive and highly legible. The Montblanc 1858 GMT indicates the second time zone with a red square that moves around the outside of the dial. This red square is positioned next to a fixed black anodized aluminium bezel with a 24-hour clock. This system also indicates the half hours. Other functions include a date and central seconds hand. The timepiece is housed in a 42mm stainless steel case and comes with a black sunray dial and an interchangeable black rubber strap with fine adjustment system. An engraving on the case back shows the continents, oceans, and names of cities in each of the 24 time zones, offering a worldtime indication.

products.name: 1858 Iced Black Sea 41mm Mens Watch
products.description: The pioneering Minerva timepieces of the 1920s and 30s, created with exploration in mind, inspired Montblanc's '1858' collection. This stainless steel 'Iced Sea' reference has a unidirectional bezel enhanced with four luminescent cardinal points and is powered by a Swiss-made calibre MB 24. 17 automatic movement. Its black 'Glacier' dial is engraved with the iconic Mont Blanc mountain range, a compass and two crossed ice pick-axes a true celebration of adventures in the great outdoors.

products.name: 1858 Iced Blue Sea 41mm Mens Watch
products.description: The first-ever sports diving watch for Montblanc, the Montblanc 1858 Iced Sea Automatic Date 129369 is inspired by the Mer de Glace - Sea of Ice - the main glacier of the Mont-Blanc Massif. Featuring a unidirectional bi-colour bezel, an engraved caseback and tapered interchangeable steel bracelet. With a 41mm case housing a navy blue glacial pattern dial, this automatic date edition is complete with hours and minutes indexes, a date window at 3 o'clock and second hand in centre.

products.name: 1858 Iced Sea Automatic Date 41mm Mens Watch
products.description: The first-ever sports diving watch for Montblanc, the Montblanc Iced Sea Automatic Date features a glacier pattern dial that gives the impression of looking into the depths of a glacier. This blue glacial pattern dial is inspired by the Mer de Glace - Sea of Ice - the main glacier of the Mont-Blanc Massif. Its texture was achieved using an almost-forgotten ancestral technique called gratté-boisé. The timepiece is housed in a 41mm stainless steel case and comes with a unidirectional bi-colour ceramic bezel, an engraved case back, and a tapered interchangeable stainless steel bracelet with fine adjustment for precision fitting. The timepiece conforms to the ISO 6425 norm for diving watches and is water-resistant to 300 metres.

products.name: Iced Sea Automatic Date 41mm
products.description: Capturing the colour of the setting sun over the glacier, this Montblanc Iced Sea Automatic Date combines a black glacier pattern dial with a warm bronze case. The glacier pattern dial is inspired by the Mer de Glace - Sea of Ice - the main glacier of the Mont-Blanc Massif. Its texture was achieved using an almost-forgotten ancestral technique called gratté-boisé. This bronze edition comes with a bi-colour unidirectional anodized aluminum bezel, a 3D engraving on the bronze-coated titanium case back, and an interchangeable black rubber strap with brown outline and fine adjustment system. It is water-resistant to 300 meters.

products.name: 1858 Limited Edition Automatic Chronograph
products.description: The Montblanc 1858 product line is inspired by the legendary professional Minerva watches from the 1920s and 1930s which were conceived for military use and exploration. Reinterpreting these historical timepieces, the Montblanc 1858 product line expresses the spirit of mountain exploration, embodying the modern trend of returning to nature. The Montblanc 1858 Automatic Chronograph Limited Edition 1858 watch comes with a bi-directional steel bezel that has been enhanced with shiny black ceramic and the four engraved luminescent cardinal points. The 42 mm stainless steel case features both polished and satin finishes and has been engraved with the Mont Blanc mountain, a compass, and two crossed ice pick-axes, as a nod to the Spirit of Mountain Exploration. For legibility and design, the black dial contrasts with historical beige luminescent cathedral-shaped hands and beige luminescent Arabic numerals. The timepiece is completed with a black calf leather strap with beige stitching.

products.name: Montblanc Star Legacy Automatic 126080
products.description: In 1906, Hamburg, Alfred Nehemias and August Eberstein understood that with the turn of the century, a desire for innovation and ingenuity had started to snowball in modern society. Having realised this, Nehemias and Eberstein decided to produce Simplicissimus Pens, Latin for Simple Pens. A design which saw the ink-well incorporated into the main body of fountain pens. Shortly after this, new partners Claus Johannes, Christian Lausen, and Wilhelm Dziambor took over and drove the business to international success. In 1909, the Rouge et Noir was released, which included the name Montblanc. In 1910 the name was registered as the companies trademark. Presenting this Mens Montblanc timepiece from the Star collection. Showcasing a stunning 43mm Stainless Steel case with scratch-resistant Sapphire crystal glass and a charming ivory dial with Roman numeral hour markers. Other features include an alligator strap with a secure deployment clasp and a powerful Automatic movement. Water resistant up to 50 metres.

products.name: Star Legacy Chronograph Day & Date 43mm
products.description: The Montblanc Star Legacy product line takes its inspiration from Minerva’s heritage and the company’s pocket watches that were made during the late 19th century and early 20th century. The Montblanc Star Legacy Chronograph Day & Date offers useful complications and provides classical watchmaking along with a stylish, yet casual look. It comes in a 43 mm stainless steel case and features an ivory-coloured dial with 18 K rose gold-coated Roman numerals, indexes and luminescent hands for the time functions and blued hands for the chronograph readings. The timepiece is equipped with the MB 25. 07 chronograph movement that indicates the elapsed seconds via a central chronograph seconds hand, the elapsed minutes in a 30-minute counter, and the elapsed hours in a 12-hour counter. The day and date displays can be found in apertures at three o’clock. The Montblanc Star Legacy Chronograph Day & Date is completed with a stainless steel 3 links bracelet that has been partly polished and partly satin-finished.

products.name: 1858 Monopusher Chrono 42mm Mens Watch
products.description: The collected knowledge of centuries, decades of experience, years of development and hundreds of hours of dedicated labour all culminate in the coming to life of a Montblanc timepiece. To create masterpieces of utmost precision and immaculate perfection, the watchmakers at the Montblanc Manufactures in Villeret and Le Locle put their pride, passion and soul into each timepiece.

products.name: 1858 Automatic Chronograph 0 Oxygen The 8000 42mm Mens Watch
products.description: Paying tribute to the world’s highest peaks and the alpinists who dare to climb them enduring extreme conditions, the Montblanc 1858 Automatic Chronograph 0 Oxygen The 8000 is housed in a 42mm stainless steel case totally devoid of oxygen. This has several advantages for explorers by eliminating fogging and preventing oxidization, thus allowing the movement to last far longer with greater precision. The timepiece is powered by the MB 25. 13 automatic chronograph and features a fluted bi-directional black ceramic bezel with luminescent cardinal points; a dark grey Sfumato glacier patterned dial with orange accents and blue luminescence. The case back is engraved with the “Spirit of Exploration” pattern and the watch is fitted with an interchangeable tapered stainless steel bracelet with a fine adjustment system.

products.name: 1858 Geosphere UltraBlack Limited Edition Mens Watch
products.description: The Montblanc 1858 watch series is inspired by the professional Minerva watches from the 1920s and 1930s which were conceived for military use and exploration. It combines a 42mm round shaped distressed stainless steel case and black leather strap with a traditional buckle. It has a black analogue dial with white luminescent rhodium-coated Arabic numerals and indexes, a date display, and two 24 hour sub-dials, all of which is protected beneath domed scratch resistant sapphire crystal glass with a double anti-reflective coating. Power is generated by the Calibre MB 29. 25 automatic movement with 26 jewels and a power reserve of up to 42 hours. This model also has a water resistance of up to 100 metres.

products.name: 1858 Geoshphere 0 Oxygen The 8000 42mm Mens Watch
products.description: Paying tribute to the world’s highest peaks and the alpinists who dare to climb them enduring extreme conditions, this Montblanc 1858 Geosphere 0 Oxygen The 8000 is housed in a 42mm titanium case totally devoid of oxygen. This has several advantages for explorers by eliminating fogging and preventing oxidization, thus allowing the movement to last far longer with greater precision. The timepiece is powered by the MB 29. 25 automatic movement with Manufacture Worldtime complication which includes the time of the 24-hour zones readable on the luminescent continents of the 3D turning Northern and Southern Hemisphere globes, day & night indications, dual time display, and a date. The timepiece also comes with a fluted bi-directional black ceramic bezel with luminescent cardinal points, a sfumato dark grey glacier pattern dial with orange accents, and an interchangeable titanium bracelet with a taper and fine adjustment system. products.name: Big Crown 80th Anniversary Edition 40mm Mens Watch
products.description: On the 80th anniversary of the Oris Big Crown Pointer Date, Oris is proud to present a special edition in bronze with a green dial. No watch tells the historic tale of independent Swiss watchmaker Oris quite like the iconic Big Crown Pointer Date. It’s a potent symbol of Oris’s philosophy, and some say that without it Oris might not enjoy its current status as a leader in Swiss Made mechanical watches. In 1938, Oris introduced a pioneering watch for pilots. It had an oversized crown so that glove-wearing airmen could easily adjust it, and an unusual complication – a date indicated by a central pointer hand. To mark the 80th anniversary of this landmark watch, Oris has created the Big Crown Pointer Date 80th Anniversary Edition, a special piece with a 40mm case, fluted bezel and oversized crown cast in bronze, and a striking green dial. Bronze patinates naturally as it oxidises, so that each watch will take on a unique finish over time. The deep green of the dial also has a natural feel, complementing the bronze case. Multi-piece bronze case with bronze screw-in security crown, dark brown leather strap made with sustainably sourced and produced materials, bronze buckle. Water Resistance 5 bar.

products.name: Aquis Date Relief 43.5mm Unisex Watch Grey
products.description: Deeply rooted in Hölstein, Switzerland. Oris strives to make the world a little brighter and bring joy. That’s why the people who come together at our factory often share more than just their passion for watches. They’re united by the search for new paths, their commitment to sustainability and their belief in the strength of community. More than 120 years have passed since Oris was founded by two independent, entrepreneurial watchmakers. Today, Oris is proudly independent and only makes watches with mechanical movements, many of them created in-house. Like the Calibre 400 series, which promises a five-day power reserve, anti-magnetism, and a 10-year warranty and 10-year recommended service intervals.

products.name: Divers Sixty-Five 38mm Cotton Candy Bronze Green Automatic Watch
products.description: The Divers Sixty-Five looks back to Oris’s first divers watches, particularly an iconic 1965 model. Under their vintage aesthetic, the new pieces are engineered using state-of-the-art manufacturing techniques. A new start. With spring comes fresh hope, and with it (more so than ever this year) light at the end of a long, dark tunnel. The new Divers Sixty-Five Cotton Candy has a simple ambition – to bring a smile. It picks up the all-bronze case, bezel, crown and bracelet combination engineered by Oris for the Hölstein Edition 2020, and adds a peppy palette of dial colours in either sky blue, wild green or lipstick pink. The 38mm case is intentionally unisex, while bronze creates its own story by patinating during the natural, charming process of oxidisation. Each model is powered by an automatic Swiss Made mechanical movement and delivers the same quality standards the Divers Sixty-Five collection is now synonymous with: domed sapphire crystal, water-resistant to 10 bar (100 metres) and hands and applied indices filled with bright Super-Lumi Nova®. Why Cotton Candy? Because these are watches designed to bring warmth and the optimism of better times.

products.name: Big Crown Pointer Date Calibre 403 40mm Mens Watch Red
products.description: The story of the Big Crown Pointer Date is the stuff of Oris legend. Its genesis began in the 1930s when Oris was a fast-growing independent company, known around the world for its precision wristwatches. The brief was to produce a watch that would serve a new clientele with very specific needs. For pilots, a watch would need to be as precise and reliable as any, but it would also need to be easy to use and read. Cockpits were uncomfortable places: cramped, hard, often cold, and always unforgiving. Oris’ solution was to produce a simple round watch in a stainless steel case, with a black dial and large Arabic numerals at 12, 3, and 9, and an oversized crown that could be gripped by a gloved aviator. It would also feature a date complication, indicated by a central hand with a red arrow tip. This way, it would be functional and legible, a toolwatch for one of the most demanding jobs imaginable. Little would its creators have known, but their practical, high-functioning watch of 1938 would become a design staple, one of the most recognizable watches in all of watchmaking. Today, almost 90 years since that first release, the Big Crown Pointer Date – as it’s become known – is our signature design and a Swiss watchmaking icon.

products.name: ProPilot X Calibre 400 Laser 39mm Mens Watch
products.description: Meet the new Pro Pilot X Calibre 400 Laser. Its 39mm case and bracelet are both in titanium, and it’s powered by our game-changing Calibre 400 five-day automatic. But the story this time is in its colourful dial, which is created using an innovative lasering technique never seen in watchmaking before. Incredibly, there’s not a drop of colour pigment in it. Instead, the blue, green and violet finish is created by reflected light. It’s a technological beauty. The technique behind the watch’s colourful dial is state-of-the-art. But it’s inspired by the principles of biomimicry, whereby technology reflects the wonders of nature. Think of the iridescent wings of a beetle and the way they reflect light to appear a bluey-green. It’s the same thing here. We developed the technique in partnership with Switzerland’s prestigious ETH Zürich university and this is the first time it’s been used in a watch. The result? Joy on the wrist.
