The strap, made of rubber with a textile-like texture and saddle stitching, combines elegance with water resistance. Designed to complement the active rhythms of contemporary life, this model epitomizes horological expertise and craftsmanship.

products.name: TONDA PF Minute Rattrapante Steel Platinum Sand Grey 40mm Mens Watch
products.description: The TONDA PF Minute Rattrapante Steel Platinum Sand Grey by Parmigiani Fleurier represents a world-first revolution in time reading and measurement, redefining contemporary horological standards. Its innovative design and intuitive functionality offer an unparalleled time-reading experience. The sophisticated dial features an hour hand and two overlaid minute hands, while the automatic PF052 movement with an 18-carat rose gold micro-rotor enhances both the aesthetics and performance of this exceptional timepiece. The Minute Rattrapante function allows for precise minute adjustments, thanks to ergonomically placed pushers at 8 o'clock for five-minute increments and at 10 o'clock for one-minute increments. Every detail, from the exquisite finishes to the integrated movement, showcases Parmigiani Fleurier's dedication to horological excellence. The TONDA PF Minute Rattrapante is more than a watch; it offers a unique experience of mastering time, thereby extending precious moments.

products.name: TONDA PF Chronograph Steel Platinum Milano Blue 42mm Mens Watch
products.description: The TONDA PF Chronograph Steel Platinum Milano Blue by Parmigiani Fleurier stands out for its seamless blend of tradition and innovation. At its core lies the PF070 manufacture movement, a state-of-the-art caliber featuring a column wheel and operating at a high frequency of 5 Hz, ensuring COSC-certified precision. This exceptional mechanism is housed in a 42 mm stainless steel case, enhanced by a finely knurled platinum bezel. The dial, with its understated elegance, is accented by a delicately sandblasted minute track and subtle blue-framed counters, ensuring optimal readability of the chronograph functions, hours, minutes, small seconds, and date. The PF logo, strategically placed at noon on a beveled oval appliqué, subtly marks the watch's exclusivity and high level of finishing. The two-level indexes and the intricate Guilloché Grain d'orge motif add a touch of visual sophistication. With this creation, Parmigiani Fleurier pays homage to horological precision, aiming to captivate connoisseurs of refined details.

products.name: TONDA PF Automatic Steel Rose Gold White Citrine 36mm Ladies Watch
products.description: The TONDA PF Automatic Steel Rose Gold White Citrine Set by Parmigiani Fleurier embodies perfectly mastered watchmaking expertise. This model elegantly combines stainless steel with rose gold, making it far more than just a stylistic success; it celebrates rose gold as a central design element rather than a mere accent. The combination of these metals, with their distinctive colors, creates perfect harmony, ideal proportions, and a unique aesthetic. The watch’s elegance is highlighted by baguette-cut diamond indexes, beautifully set on a hand-guilloché White Citrine dial. The PF770 caliber movement is enhanced by a rose gold rotor visible through the sapphire case back, revealing a finely finished movement that offers a glimpse into the essence of this horological masterpiece. The minimalist design is further enhanced by flared and curved lugs and an ergonomic bracelet, ensuring a perfect fit on the wrist. With a diameter of 36 mm, this watch represents the ideal balance between personal refinement and meticulous attention to detail, staying true to the spirit of Parmigiani Fleurier: subtle elegance accentuated by delicate lines, patterns, and curves.

products.name: TONDA PF Gregorian Annual Calendar Steel Platinum Warm Grey 42mm Mens Watch
products.description: The TONDA PF Gregorian Annual Calendar Steel Platinum Warm Grey by Parmigiani Fleurier represents a true revolution in the approach to the annual calendar, perfectly balancing mechanical sophistication and aesthetic purity. At the heart of this timepiece lies the PF339 manufacture caliber, a technical marvel that offers a retrograde date, day, month, precise moon phase for 122 years, as well as hours, minutes, and seconds. Despite the wealth of information, this watch achieves exceptional readability through an ingenious dial layout. By placing the date on the periphery, Parmigiani Fleurier preserves the characteristic aesthetic of the TONDA PF line while providing complete functionality. The watch also stands out for its design: finely skeletonized solid gold hands, a platinum bezel, and a sophisticated case structure that assert its elegance. The TONDA PF Gregorian Annual Calendar Steel Platinum Warm Grey, with its integrated bracelet and architecture reflecting the skill of a master tailor, is an ode to silhouette, fluidity, and refined taste. It is not just a watch but a tribute to time, designed to traverse eras with grace and relevance.

products.name: TONDA PF Sport Chronograph Rose Gold Silver Black COSC 42mm Mens Watch
products.description: The TONDA PF Sport Chronograph Rose Gold Silver Black COSC by Parmigiani Fleurier seamlessly blends the prestige of rose gold with sporty boldness. Its 42 mm rose gold case features a knurled bezel, reflecting a dynamic and assertive aesthetic. The dial is a guilloché masterpiece, showcasing a hand-crafted Clou triangulaire pattern, an age-old decorative technique that captures and refracts light, imparting exceptional depth. In contrast, the black sub-dials provide optimal legibility, embodying an elegant "panda" style. Powered by the PF070 manufacture movement, this chronograph watch operates at a high frequency of 5Hz, ensuring chronometric precision certified by COSC, and boasts a generous power reserve of 65 hours. This caliber, visible through a sapphire case back, is adorned with exceptional hand-finished details, including beveling and Côtes de Genève decoration, and is crowned by an elegantly skeletonized rose gold rotor. The rubber strap, with its textile finish and saddle stitching, evokes elegance while offering comfort suited to an active lifestyle. This watch is not only an instrument of unparalleled timekeeping precision but also a statement of style.

products.name: TONDA PF Hijri Perpetual Calendar Green 42mm Mens Watch
products.description: The Parmigiani Fleurier Tonda PF, reference PFH983-1020001-100182, is a testament to the art of high horology, embodying sophistication and a profound respect for watchmaking tradition. Crafted for the discerning gentleman, its 42-millimeter stainless steel case houses an exceptional green dial, presenting an elegant stage for the display of time. This masterpiece is powered by the PF009 caliber, a self-winding manufacture movement, ensuring precision and reliability. The watch's complexity is further highlighted by its perpetual calendar function, meticulously indicating the date, weekday, month, and year, alongside a moon phase display, enriching the dial with a touch of celestial wonder. Its platinum bezel and sapphire crystal case back, which is anti-reflective on both sides, underscore the watch's luxurious appeal, while the stainless steel bracelet secures the timepiece with grace. Water-resistant to 10 bar and featuring a 48-hour power reserve, this watch is as functional as it is beautiful. The Tonda PF is completed with a folding clasp, ensuring a perfect fit and seamless elegance for every occasion.

products.name: TONDA PF Skeleton Steel Platinum Graphite 40mm Mens Watch
products.description: The TONDA PF Skeleton Steel Platinum Graphite by Parmigiani Fleurier embodies the pinnacle of mechanical purity. In this delicate exercise of skeleton watchmaking, Parmigiani Fleurier's craftsmanship reaches new heights. The airy structure of steel and platinum, housing the intricately openworked PF777 manufacture movement, invites deep contemplation of its mechanics. The rose gold oscillating weight, visible through the sapphire crystal case back, becomes a moving work of art, gracefully winding the barrel. The openworked Graphite grey dial subtly combines sandblasted and satin-finished surfaces with suspended indexes, creating a complex yet minimalist aesthetic. The two openworked hands glide effortlessly over the dial, ensuring easy readability. The watch's clean and essential architecture, with its knurled and polished bezel and fluidly graphic bracelet, is celebrated by the most discerning horological purists.

products.name: TONDA PF GMT Rattrapante Rose Gold Milano Blue 40mm Mens Watch
products.description: The TONDA PF GMT Rattrapante Rose Gold Milano Blue from Parmigiani Fleurier is an exemplar of horological innovation, seamlessly blending timeless aesthetics with advanced technology. Crafted entirely in rose gold, this 40mm watch stands out for its distinctive elegance. The Milano Blue dial, detailed with a Guilloché Grain d'orge pattern, features rose gold indexes for superb readability. At its core, the automatic manufacture movement PF051, highlighted by a rose gold micro-rotor, powers the watch. This model boasts a GMT split-second complication that allows for the intuitive reading of two time zones simultaneously, making it ideal for global travelers. With a simple press of the pusher at 8 o'clock, the local time can be adjusted using the rhodium-plated gold hand, while the rose gold hand displays the reference time. The rose gold crown includes a mechanism to realign the hands, making it easy to switch back to the original time zone. This fusion of functionality and elegant design renders it an exceptional timekeeping tool and a daily wearable piece of art.

products.name: Integral 33mm Ladies Watch
products.description: Iconic for introducing high-tech ceramic into watchmaking, the Integral collection from Rado presents parallel lines and fine craftsmanship that remains true to the original pioneering design. Presented on a stainless steel and black ceramic bracelet and housed by a 22. 7mm matching case, this Rado Integral watch boasts a sophisticated black dial. Set beneath sapphire crystal glass for protection, the dial is equipped with Silver-tone hands, sparkling diamond dot hour markers at 3, 6, 9 and 12 o’clock and Rado’s iconic branding. Powered by a reliable Quartz movement and water resistant to 50 metres, this watch blurs the boundaries between function and form. Discover the full Rado collection.

products.name: Centrix Diamonds 30.5mm Ladies Watch
products.description: The classic Centrix Quartz Diamonds watch has been reworked not only technically, but also aesthetically. The modified model has a rounded sapphire crystal that extends all the way to the edge and a curved case blending with the curved crystal edge. The overall appearance of this iconic timepiece is completed with adjusted case lugs and a bracelet made of polished yellow gold-coloured PVD-coated stainless steel with black high-tech ceramic middle links. The black facetted dial with 12 diamonds has an opulent effect created by stamping a shaped dial and then filling it with lacquer. Thanks to the Preci Drive and Heavy Drive features in the calibre R079 quartz movement, the watch has greater accuracy and resistance to shocks. The watch is water-resistant down to 50 m.

products.name: Centrix Diamonds 39.5 mm, Quartz Ladies Watch
products.description: The classic Centrix Quartz Diamonds watch has been reworked not only technically, but also aesthetically. The modified model has a rounded sapphire crystal that extends all the way to the edge and a curved case blending with the curved crystal edge. The overall appearance of this iconic timepiece is completed with adjusted case lugs and a bracelet made of polished yellow gold-coloured PVD-coated stainless steel with black high-tech ceramic. The black sunray dial with 12 diamonds, emphasised with the printed “jubilé” logo, matches perfectly with the yellow gold-coloured hands. Thanks to the Preci Drive and Heavy Drive features in the calibre R073 quartz movement, the watch has greater accuracy and resistance to shocks. The watch is water-resistant down to 50 m.

products.name: Captain Cook Green Automatic Mens Watch
products.description: The Rado Captain Cook watch is perhaps one of the Swiss watch manufacturer’s most iconic models, and despite its release almost sixty years ago, it remains a resonating piece for watch lovers and aficionados alike today. It’s nautical, vintage-inspired aesthetic takes inspiration from the original Rado Captain Cook collection released in 1962 and is named after British navigator and explorer James Cook. With vintage details and styling true to the original, and up-to-date features that make it a match for modern wearers, Captain Cook is a watch designed to stand the test of time. The new 42 mm Captain Cook is water-resistant to 30 bar (300m) and has already proved a hit with contemporary watch wearers and modern explorers. The new Rado Captain Cook Automatic watch is brought to life in a new and improved form for the modern-day wearer with a polished stainless steel case, high-tech ceramic bezel and the Swiss watch manufacturer’s Easy Clip System which allows you to change the stainless steel bracelet quickly and easily without the need for any tools.

products.name: Captain Cook 39mm Unisex Watch
products.description: Famous the world over for its ground-breaking designs and use of pioneering materials, Rado is a Swiss brand with a wealth of history and expertise. Rado watches are instantly recognisable with their modern watch face designs and distinguished logo motif. Behind each face is years’ worth of visionary research and cutting-edge technology.

products.name: Captain Cook 39mm Unisex Watch
products.description: Famous the world over for its ground-breaking designs and use of pioneering materials, Rado is a Swiss brand with a wealth of history and expertise. Rado watches are instantly recognisable with their modern watch face designs and distinguished logo motif. Behind each face is years’ worth of visionary research and cutting-edge technology.

products.name: True 40mm Unisex Watch
products.description: Reinventing luxury timekeeping, the Rado True collection offers stunning aesthetics and incredible functionality. Presented in a 40. 1mm ceramic case, this Rado True watch features a sophisticated grey dial enhanced with glistening diamond dot hour markers, Rose Gold-tone hands, and a date display at 3 o’clock. Powered by a reliable automatic movement, this high-performance timepiece is water resistant to 50 metres and fastens with a ceramic bracelet. Discover the full Rado collection.

products.name: DiaStar Original Skeleton 38mm Unisex Watch
products.description: The Dia Star Original Skeleton features another variant of the high-quality R808 automatic calibre, anthracite-grey coated and complemented by various elements in its workings, for a lovely visual dance of contrasts. Thanks to sapphire crystal windows on both front and back, the automatic movement can be appreciated in full technical elegance, providing 80 hours of power reserve. An anti-magnetic Nivachron™ hairspring ensures that everything stays extremely precise and reliable, in a movement that has been tested in a full five positions. Its open structure, and the impressive R808 skeleton movement give a lighter, airier note to the new Dia Star Original, a perfect design counterpoint inside the visual frame created by the polished yellow gold coloured Ceramos™ bezel. The darker tone is further set off by floating yellow gold coloured indexes and hands with white Super-Lumi Nova®, for great readability even in low-light conditions.

products.name: DiaStar Original 38mm Unisex Watch
products.description: The unique Dia Star Original has a diameter of 38 mm and is water resistant down to 100 m. Framed by an ultra shiny yellow gold couloured Ceramos coiffe with polished angles and detailing set over a matching, yellow gold couloured PVD coated stainless steel case, this beautiful watch is rounded off with a parallel stripe faceted sapphire crystal. Specifications include a gold brushed dial with two directions, yellow gold coloured hands with white Super Lumi Nova, and a white day date display. The dial features eleven full cut diamonds, emphasised with the dark grey coloured printed jubilé logo. The Rado R764 automatic movement offers 80 hours of power reserve, with an antimagnetic Nivachron balance spring. The bracelet is made of yellow gold PVD coated polished and brushed stainless steel.

products.name: Integral Diamonds 31.5mm Ladies Watch
products.description: Since your taste is impeccable, you only ever wear the best, and choose the Rado Integral for precisely that reason. The slim, sleek case in polished stainless steel retains the Rado Integral’s signature square shape, its proportions aligned with the slightly tapered bracelet to enhance the aesthetic pleasure of the look. The case holds a curved and bevelled sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating and black metallization. The dial features a black lacquer finish beneath the traditional four Top Wesselton diamonds at cardinal hours, silvered Rado and jubilé logos and rhodium-plated hands. This iconic Rado design offers a large, easy-to-read dial and high-tech materials for maximum comfort. The Rado R218 quartz movement delivers reliable timekeeping that meets the Swiss standard for certified chronometers. With its cylindrical sapphire crystal and the luxurious feel of black high-tech ceramic links on the stainless steel bracelet, the Rado Integral is a perfect fit for your sense of high style. And you’ll note with pleasure the curved glass that aligns with the curve of your wrist, a sure sign of elegance, comfort and sophistication.

products.name: Centrix Moonphase 35mm Ladies Watch Black
products.description: Measuring the passage of time and the passage of the moon, the Rado Centrix Moonphase is a timeless addition to the Rado range. Curved sapphire crystal, with antireflective coating on both sides, and high-tech ceramic bracelet middle links make the watch durable, Rado high-tech materials keep the watch looking as new. The earth, a black mother of pearl sky, a yellow gold coloured horizon and the moonphase complication mean the watch dial is a true work of art. A polished and applied moon really stands out on the dial. The look is completed by 12 Top Wesselton, VS-SI, diamonds. Black high-tech ceramic bracelet middle links sit against your skin, the watch is comfortable as well as durable. Yellow gold coloured accents complete the look, the watch is sure to standout. The Rado calibre R084 quartz, two hand movement with date and moonphase indicator, keeps the watch accurate and reliable.

products.name: Captain Cook 42mm Mens Watch - Green
products.description: This 42 mm Captain Cook Automatic watch comes with a lacquered green-to-black gradient dial, which perfectly matches the stainless-steel bracelet with yellow-gold-coloured middle links. The rose-gold-coloured hands and indexes with white Super-Lumi Nova ensure excellent visibility. For higher accuracy, the Rado R763 automatic movement inside exceeds standard accuracy test requirements from 3 to 5 positions. The polished stainless-steel case with its box-shaped sapphire crystal offers a unique bubble effect for a stand-out look. The Easy Clip system allows you to change the straps quickly and easily, customising your watch and personalising your style.

products.name: Centrix Chronograph 41mm Unisex Watch
products.description: Experience the harmonious blend of artistic expression and refined design with the Centrix Chronograph. Crafted in stainless steel and treated to a yellow gold-coloured PVD coating, the 41 mm case is crowned with a curved sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating on both sides, ensuring impeccable readability. Beating at its heart, the Calibre R312 quartz chronograph sets a new standard of precision. Equipped with 22 jewels and a six-hand configuration, this movement integrates Precidrive and Heavydrive technologies to ensure unwavering accuracy of +/- 10 seconds per year. The black sunray dial, enhanced by yellow gold applied indexes with white Super Lumi Nova®, exudes refined sophistication. Three meticulously arranged counters include a 30-minute counter, a one tenth of a second tracker offering precise chronograph functionality, and a small seconds at 6 hour. The discreet date window at four o’clock adds a touch of practical elegance. The overall appearance of this iconic timepiece is completed with elegantly adjusted case lugs and a bracelet made of polished stainless steel treated to a yellow gold-coloured PVD coating with black high-tech ceramic middle links, secured by a triple-fold brushed stainless steel clasp.

products.name: Integral Diamonds 31mm Unisex Watch
products.description: The iconic Integral has been redesigned to suit the needs and preferences of modern wearers, but the new models remain true to the original in look and feel. The first Rado to feature high-tech ceramic in 1986, it is an enduring piece that continues to delight its fans and attract new enthusiasts. Now with the added allure of diamonds. Rado Watch Integral Ceramic. This enduring Rado square watch is a timepiece sure to make a statement. The iconic Rado watches Integral has been redesigned to suit the contemporary needs and preferences of todays wearers, remaining true to the original look and feel. The first Rado to feature high tech ceramic in 1986, it is a distinctive piece that continues to delight its fans and attract new enthusiasts. Discover men’s ceramic watches and ceramic watches for women in the Integral family.

products.name: True Round Automatic Open Heart 40mm Mens Watch
products.description: Experience the perfect blend of design excellence and material mastery with the Rado True Round Open Heart. This remarkable timepiece showcases a captivating open heart design, allowing you to admire the intricate movements of the automatic Rado caliber R734, a pure expression of the art of watchmaking. Fitted with an antimagnetic Nivachron hairspring, it delivers a power reserve of 80 hours. It has a polished plasma high tech ceramic monobloc case and crown and a titanium case back whose sapphire crystal reveals an eye catching view of the movement. It features a gray sunray dial with rose gold colored bevels and a gray printed minute track. Fittingly, this study in gray is delivered on a polished plasma high tech ceramic bracelet with a titanium 3 fold clasp. The watch is water resistant down to 50m. The Rado True Round Open Heart is drawn to watches that are relentlessly contemporary, but which also have a timelessness and style that make them true keepsakes.

products.name: True Round Automatic Open Heart 40mm Mens Watch
products.description: Experience the perfect blend of design excellence and material mastery with the Rado True Round Open Heart. This remarkable timepiece showcases a captivating open heart design, allowing you to admire the intricate movements of the automatic Rado caliber R734, a pure expression of the art of watchmaking. Fitted with an antimagnetic Nivachron hairspring, it delivers a power reserve of 80 hours. It has a polished black high tech ceramic monobloc case and crown and a black PVD coated titanium case whose sapphire crystal allows an unobstructed view of the movement. It features a black sunray dial with rose gold colored bevels and a gray printed minute track. Fittingly, this study in black is delivered on a polished black high tech ceramic bracelet with a titanium 3 fold clasp. The watch is water resistant down to 50 m. The Rado True Round Open Heart is drawn to watches that are relentlessly contemporary, but which also have a timelessness and style that make them true keepsakes.

products.name: Integral Diamonds 23mm Ladies Watch
products.description: You identify the Rado Integral by its traditional four-colour dial, the sleek, square case and crown in stainless steel with polished rose gold PVD. And yet this one is even more special, with its mother-of-pearl dial, rose gold-coloured hour and minute hands and rose gold-coloured metallization. The lightly tapered bracelet in stainless steel with rose gold PVD and polished white high-tech ceramic links aligns with the exquisite proportions of the square case. Unmatched style and comfort combine in the anti-reflective, edge-to-edge curved and bevelled sapphire crystal, adding lustre to the dial. High style dominates the minimalist design, backed by the robust R209 quartz movement for reliable timekeeping. The sapphire crystal and high-tech ceramic links offer the luxury of lightweight comfort, topped by a telling detail: the curve of the glass is echoed by the bracelet as it adapts to the curves of your wrist. The epitome of style and high-end elegance: the Rado Integral in white, rose gold colouring, and a lustrous white mother-of-pearl dial.

products.name: Integral Diamonds 23mm Ladies Watch
products.description: You’re a connoisseur, are you not? Only the finest, most beautiful things in life will do. With its traditional Rado four-diamond dial and signature comfort, the Rado Integral is an obvious choice. The stainless steel case is a yellow gold colour, like the hands circling above the diamonds. The yellow gold-coloured bracelet in stainless steel frames glossy black high-tech ceramic middle links. Anti-reflective coating on the edge-to-edge, curved and bevelled sapphire crystal with black metallization ensures perfect legibility. Together, the slim case profile and high-tech ceramic links deliver optimum comfort on the wrist. The black lacquered dial with printed yellow Rado and jubilé logos underscores the minimalist aesthetic, while the 6-jewel, two-hand R209 quartz movement guarantees precision timing 24/7. For connoisseurs only, a subtle detail: The curved shape of the glass flows smoothly into the bracelet as it adapts to the curve of your wrist.

products.name: Integral Diamonds 31.5mm Ladies Watch
products.description: Your taste for the finer things in life is evident in every move. You love comfort, exquisite design, and the warmth of yellow gold. Your choice of the Rado Integral says it all. The iconic square case in stainless steel with a polished yellow gold surface holds an edge-to-edge, bevelled sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating and black metallization. Yellow gold-coloured hands glide above the lacquered black dial and the signature 4 top-class diamonds. Superb timekeeping is guaranteed by the movement ticking inside: the Rado R218, with 8 jewels and precision in line with the Swiss standard for certified chronometers. The elegant design of this Rado icon blends the comfort of high-tech ceramic bracelet middle links on the lightly tapered bracelet with a splendid sapphire crystal. Icing on the cake: the curve of the glass aligns with the gentle curves of your wrist, irrefutable proof of your refined tastes and love of elegance.

products.name: Integral Diamonds 23mm Ladies Watch Brown
products.description: At first glance you take in the Rado four-diamond dial, the rose gold colouring and the high-tech ceramic links. A traditional Rado Integral. And then you take a closer look – at the dial – yes, it’s mother-of-pearl, in brown. Exceptional. Eye-catching. Elegant. The stainless steel case with a polished rose gold PVD surface is flanked by a stainless steel bracelet with rose gold-coloured PVD and polished brown high-tech ceramic links. Rose gold-coloured metallization frames the anti-reflective, curved and bevelled sapphire crystal protecting the lustrous mother-of-pearl dial. The minimalist, signature Rado design is powered by the R209 quartz movement: Swiss-made precision in a 6-jewel two-hander. The sapphire crystal glass and high-tech ceramic links ensure comfort, and the curves of the glass align with the bracelet as it adapts to the curve of your wrist (a detail for the connoisseur). An iconic Rado Integral, enhanced by a disarmingly elegant mother-of-pearl dial.

products.name: True Square Open Heart Unisex Watch
products.description: At Rado, we made our name producing square high-tech ceramic watches. The True Square is a new take on an iconic Rado shape. Our first watch made using a square injected monobloc high-tech ceramic case, the True Square is light, scratch-resistant and comfortable to wear. Distinctive and design-led the Rado True Square Automatic Open Heart is the shape of things to come.

products.name: Centrix 30.5mm Unisex Watch Brown
products.description: Famous the world over for its ground-breaking designs and use of pioneering materials, Rado is a Swiss brand with a wealth of history and expertise. Rado watches are instantly recognisable with their modern watch face designs and distinguished logo motif. Behind each face is years’ worth of visionary research and cutting-edge technology. Both men’s and women’s watches are available in the Rado collections – always with a focus on comfort, style and durability. Rado is known as the Master of Materials for the way it has revolutionised traditional watchmaking, leading the industry by introducing high-tech ceramic, ultra-light high-tech ceramic, colourful high-tech ceramic and Ceramos™ to its design-led collections. An award-winning designer with numerous prestigious international prizes to its name, and considered the most forward-thinking design player in the watch industry today, Rado has always been a pioneer and leader, setting the standard and raising the bar.

products.name: Captain Cook Automatic 42mm Mens Watch
products.description: The Captain Cook Automatic features a 42mm polished stainless steel case and crown. On top, a polished stainless steel rotating bezel with a polished blue high tech ceramic bezel insert with engraved numbers and markers in matt white Super Lumi Nova. Powering this watch is a Rado calibre R763, an automatic movement that delivers an impressive 80 hour power reserve. The rhodium coloured hour and minute hands are treated with white Super Lumi Nova and the tip of the central seconds hand is treated in yellow Super Lumi Nova, a playful nod to the colour of tennis balls. The Captain Cook Automatic watch is delivered with a stainless steel bracelet and a blue leather pouch. A pair of strap options is available including a classic blue leather strap or a blue and white NATO style textile strap.

products.name: Captain Cook Tennis Limited Edition 42mm Mens Watch
products.description: The Captain Cook x Tennis Limited Edition blends Rados unmistakable signature with the world of professional tennis dynamic, stylish, and thoughtfully designed down to the last detail. Its 39 mm stainless steel case with a brushed high-tech ceramic bezel is water-resistant to 300 metres, while the refined stainless steel bracelet comes with three extra NATO straps that invite you to play with style: grass, hard court, clay each colour a tribute to the Grand Slam stage. Limited to 1985 pieces, this model is presented in a sleek grey leather case for those who combine sporty spirit with timeless luxury.

products.name: Captain Cook X European Cricket Special Edition 42mm Mens Watch Blue
products.description: Designed for European Cricket to mark Rado’s status as Official Timing Partner, this watch exudes pure athletic elegance. Playful design cues elevate the Captain Cook’s legendary sporting pedigree. Three golden dots channel cricket stumps, while subtle red touches pay tribute to the sport’s iconic red leather balls – the minute track resembles their stitching. Robust hands with Super-Lumi Nova® inserts make timekeeping effortless in all conditions. A scratch-resistant high-tech ceramic bezel insert and anti-reflective chevé-box shape sapphire crystal maximise performance. Its Rado calibre R763 automatic movement with 80-hour power reserve brings unbeatable reliability. Three strap options allow it to flex – in seconds with the Easy Clip System– from rugged to stylish or formal. A perfect blend of form and function.

products.name: Captain Cook Over-Pole Limited Edition 39mm Unisex Watch
products.description: The Captain Cook Over-Pole is back! A stunning new Limited Edition reprises the key features of previous versions, in particular the R862 Worldtimer manual-winding movement. Robust, precise, and guaranteed to perform thanks to rigorous in-house testing in 5 separate positions, it is mounted within a bold 39 mm case. Côtes-de-Genève surface finishing, blued screws and gold-coloured details are easily admired through the sapphire crystal on the back. As sleek as it handsome, the new version comes with a stylish yellow gold PVD stainless steel bracelet with three-fold clasp. The bracelet is easily exchanged with a rugged brown leather strap thanks to Rado’s Easy-Clip system. In addition, the new Over-Pole comes with a practical leather pouch to store the watch and extra strap, and is accompanied by an official Limited Edition Certificate.

products.name: LaCoupole Diamonds 31mm Ladies Watch Black
products.description: La Coupole stands as a tribute to the icons of yesterday, redefined for today’s sophisticated wearer. An expression of refined glamour, engineered with the precision and innovation only Rado can offer. Its 31 mm monobloc case in polished black high-tech ceramic is crowned by a domed sapphire crystal, elevated by a black & silver coloured metallised border. The case is water-resistant to 5 bar (50 metres), uniting everyday resilience with enduring elegance. The result is a silhouette that is unmistakably Rado—sleek, sculptural, and timeless. The black dial features wave-shaped markings filled with lacquer, creating an opulent three-dimensional effect. 11 Top Wesselton full-cut diamonds serve as hour markers, bringing quiet brilliance to the dial, while a date window at 6 o’clock offers refined functionality. At its heart beats the 8-jewel quartz Calibre R218, elevated by Preci Drive™ technology for exceptional precision. Securing the case, the bracelet crafted from polished black high-tech ceramic and enriched with decorative stainless-steel elements and clasp completes the design with seamless harmony. The La Coupole is an emblem of grace: designed to be desired and crafted to endure.

products.name: True Square Automatic Skeleton 38mm Unisex Watch
products.description: The Rado True Square Skeleton unites complex high-tech materials and ultra fine craftsmanship. Housed in a 38 mm matte plasma high-tech ceramic monobloc case, the R808 skeleton movement is equipped with 25 jewels and offers an 80-hour power reserve. Rigorously tested in five positions, it features an antimagnetic Nivachron™ hairspring and horizontal brushed decorations on the dial side, making this movement a pure demonstration of the Swiss legacy in high-precision engineering. Crowned by a flat sapphire crystal, the dial is a symphony of layered craftsmanship. The black sandblasted skeletonised top plate hovers above the lower plate. On this top layer, white Super Lumi Nova® indexes and meticulously printed white minute markers are precisely positioned, providing sharp legibility against the dark background. Beneath, the lower plate reveals refined horizontal brushed decoration in perfect harmony with the movement. At 4 o’clock, the iconic rotating rhodium-coloured anchor completes this dynamic and multi-dimensional display. Completing the case design is a plasma black high-tech ceramic bracelet, which flows seamlessly into a titanium 3-fold clasp, delivering the exceptional wearing comfort that high-tech ceramic provides.

products.description: Experience the harmonious blend of artistic expression and design stylings with the Rado Centrix Open Heart watch. As the constellations write their eternal stories above our heads, they build bridges for lovers to meet. A large window, reminiscent at once of dawn and dusk, beautifully frames a state-of-the-art R734 automatic movement with 80 hours of power reserve and an antimagnetic Nivachron TM hairspring, as well as a deeply elegant rippled-sunlight "ondulé soleil" motif on chosen component surfaces. products.name: Anatom Automatic 32.5mm Unisex Watch Blue
products.description: Discover the perfect harmony of comfort and aesthetics with the Rado Anatom Automatic. Powered by the Rado calibre R766 movement and equipped with a Nivachron™ antimagnetic hairspring, this watch ensures precise timekeeping with effortless elegance. Crafted for durability and sophistication, the watch boasts a black matt high-tech ceramic bezel and a cylindrical sapphire crystal with anti-reflective on the inside. The dial exhibits a captivating blue to black gradient, adding depth and allure to the watch’s design. Designed for all-day comfort, the black rubber strap is secured by a brushed stainless steel 3-fold clasp and a black matt high-tech ceramic cover. The watch is water-resistant down to 50 m. Whether you’re exploring new horizons or making a statement at a formal event, this watch is your perfect companion, representing timeless elegance and precision.

products.name: Captain Cook 43mm Mens
products.description: Charting new territory in vintage watches, the Rado Captain Cook is a natural choice for modern explorers. This automatic timepiece contains a mix of materials including high-tech ceramic and sapphire crystal, which is a style statement waiting to be discovered. Its vintage details, and up-to-date features make it the perfect watch for men and women. The Captain Cook is a watch designed to stand the test of time.

products.name: Captain Cook Chronograph 43mm
products.description: The Captain Cook Chronograph wears a characteristic box-shaped, scratch-resistant sapphire crystal with anti-reflective treatment on both faces. The thin, stylish 43 mm stainless steel case features a polished blue high-tech ceramic inlay on the bezel, complementing the silver-to-blue gradient dial. The numbers, markers and triangles are treated with Super-Lumi Nova®. products.name: King Seiko VANAC 'Tokyo Midnight' 41mm Mens Watch
products.description: 'King Seiko VANAC 'Tokyo Midnight'In the 1960s, King Seiko timepieces led Seiko Watch Corporation’s developments in world-leading technical precision. ‘King Seiko’ originated when multiple Seiko watchmakers created different watches to encourage innovation – one of the Japanese watch brand’s constant aims. In 2025, the new King Seiko VANAC channels Seiko archive inspiration from the iconic 1970s collection of the same name. Since Tokyo was the birthplace of King Seiko, the design theme of the modern VANAC is centred around this world-renowned metropolis through ‘Tokyo Horizon;’ a series of watches expressing the city of Tokyo stretching out over the skyline. products.name: Ripples Kármán Line 40.5mm Mens Watch Blue
products.description: Blue Sapphire. Thickness. Precision. The Ripples Kármán Line brings together everything that defines Speake Marin at its most technically ambitious: a sapphire crystal dial with blue metallisation, the iconic small seconds at 1: 30, and the ultra-thin La City case in 904L stainless steel. Look closer. The dial is not a surface, it is a statement. Crafted from sapphire crystal glass, its blue metallisation shifts with the light, its reverse side adorned with a sunray finish and Côtes de Genève motif that reveal themselves like a sky seen from altitude. The heart-shaped hour hand moves across rhodium-plated baton indices with quiet authority, while the minute flange, in blue PVD with an opal microbeaded finish, traces the outer limit of the dial like the boundary it is named after: the invisible threshold where Earth's atmosphere gives way to space, 100 kilometres above the surface. Beneath the sapphire crystal, the in-house SMA06 calibre beats at 5Hz, its 175 components held within a movement just 2. 5mm thin. The tungsten micro-rotor, decorated with an exclusive pattern of raised and recessed rectangles in alternating rhodium and blue PVD, is as quietly spectacular as the dial it serves. At 6. 30mm thick, the 40. 30mm La City case barely registers on the wrist. The integrated 904L steel bracelet, with micro-adjustment to the millimetre, completes a watch that leaves nothing unconsidered. The Ripples Kármán Line. Where watchmaking meets the edge of everything.
